text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Trainer. Where might you
be going?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm waiting for a friend of mine, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It seems they forgot we were going out
and
overslept. Hehe, they can be like
that sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They said it'll take them an hour to get
ready, so
I'm just relaxing while I wait.
